body:
Issue sweep: this issue is partly done on `upstream/main`. It stays open.

Already done:
- Commit `abe8ac6b6` (PR #3872) removed `ring_plan_ramped` and the dead-end ramp.
- Commits `06a3d6edf` (PR #3818) and `325187e62` (PR #3837) applied `ring_links` and `ring_side` to 2D Pocket with Outside containment (`side.around_part`).

Still open:
- The shared `ring_set` and `ring_entry` modules do not exist yet (#3750 is open).
- For a pocket with `!side.around_part`, `level_rings.rs` still builds different ring sets for Inside and Outside.
- Auto still calls `plan_passes` (`waterscan.rs`) for those pockets.
- `ring_links::for_side` skips `!side.around_part`, so those pocket rings do not link in the plane or name reasons for lifts.
- The pinning tests (`pocket_inside_and_outside_cut_the_same_rings`, `pocket_rings_do_not_lift`, and `pocket_has_no_dead_end_ramp`) do not exist yet.
